event.description: Retrain ff_dim 44 with 45000-step cosine horizon and 99.9% checkpoint early stop
event.proposal: Family: training control. Current retained frontier is 6,080 parameters at 100.000000%, a +1.000000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There are 0 prior attempts in this family, so no most recent accepted or failed in-family result exists. Attempt-0001 in feed-forward width was an optimization failure: the valid 5,824-parameter ff_dim=44 candidate trained for 30,000 steps, reached 98.85% internal validation, produced no checkpoint, and received no official score. Hypothesis: capacity is plausible but the original cosine schedule annealed before crossing the checkpoint threshold; extending its horizon to 45,000 steps and stopping after an existing internal test checkpoint reaches 99.9% repairs the same intended candidate without altering its parameterization. This is more informative than the nearest untested ff_dim=46 retry because it distinguishes schedule limitation from width capacity at the already observed near-threshold architecture.
